subject: Evidence rotation plan & sample attachments for Bluecrest Whistic profile
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@bluecrest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluecrest.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample evidence + rotation cadence for our Whistic entry

Hi Rishi,

We're revalidating vendor profiles ahead of our fiscal audit and noticed a few stale attachments on the Bluecrest Whistic entry for Redwood. Can you send a short plan for how you rotate/refresh: SOC 2 reports, architecture diagrams, and the access-control matrix? We also need a handful of sample attachments we can upload (PDF/PNG/XLSX).

Specific ask: 1) A one-paragraph rotation policy for each artifact type, 2) three representative sample files (we'll only store metadata links), and 3) any short notes on where audit evidence will live (S3, Whistic link, internal drive).

Timing: we'd like the samples and plan by end of next week (May 28).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if easier.

— Sam
Samantha Cole
Sr. Vendor Security Analyst, Bluecrest Analytics
Samantha.Cole@bluecrest.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@bluecrest.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence + rotation cadence for our Whistic entry

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and the clear list. We can get that over. Summary below and I'll attach the representative files via Vendr/Whistic link once you confirm preferred ingestion (metadata-only vs full file).

Rotation policy (high level):
- SOC 2 report (pdf): refreshed annually after our audit cycle. We publish a redacted copy to portal and keep full report in encrypted S3 for auditors. Rotation cadence: 12 months; interim updates posted as addenda.
- Architecture diagram (png/pdf): versioned with major infra changes; we do a light review every 6 months to capture network/account changes. Rotation cadence: 6 months or on-change.
- Access control matrix (xlsx): reviewed quarterly by InfoSec and HR; full snapshots retained for 18 months. Rotation cadence: 3 months.

Where evidence lives: primary storage: encrypted S3 (us-west-2) with signed, time-limited links; public-facing artifacts published to Whistic/Vendr portal with metadata records pointing back to S3.

I'll attach three sample files below (SOC2-report-2026.pdf, redwood-data-flow-diagram-v1.png, access-control-matrix-2027.xlsx) and add a short upload checklist. If you prefer we push the files directly into the portal, indicate whether you want full file upload or pointer links only.

Upload checklist (short):
- Confirm file visibility (metadata-only vs full file)
- Include short description and redaction notes (PII removed)
- Add version tag and effective date in filename

If that fits, we'll follow-up with an internal handoff to have Laura or Monica coordinate the portal upload.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: sample evidence + rotation cadence for our Whistic entry

Laura / Monica — forwarding Sam's ask from Bluecrest. They want: rotation policy blurb + three sample attachments (pdf/png/xlsx) by 5/28 and confirmation whether we will upload files or share S3 pointers.

Action items:
- Laura: can you prepare the three sample files and ensure redaction notes are added to filenames? Use version tags: v1.0 and include effective dates. Put the files in the secure S3 bucket and generate signed links.
- Monica: prepare the short metadata entries we will paste into Whistic/Vendr (title, description, version, effective_date, redaction_notes). Also confirm whether the portal wants metadata-only. I suspect Vendr accepts either; if full upload is needed, we may submit via their portal UI.

Deadline: May 27 COB to allow me one day to review before sending to Sam.

Thanks — cc'ing laura on the external reply once done.

— Rishi
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@bluecrest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluecrest.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence + rotation cadence for our Whistic entry

Rishi — this is perfect, thank you. The rotation cadence and storage notes align with our vendor policy. For ingestion we prefer metadata-only pointers to S3 for documents containing auditor-sensitive details; images (architecture diagram) may be uploaded directly to Whistic.

Next steps from our side: we'll accept the three sample metadata records and the signed links; our portal admin will paste the metadata into the Whistic entry and attach the diagram. No call required for now — I'll confirm once the portal shows the new records.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sam
